TITLE: Zugula Infrastructure Team Overview and Key Personnel

The Zugula Infrastructure Team plays a vital role in supporting internal operations and strategic initiatives across Zastama Industries. Based at the Thamhuor Campus, the team is led by Trageor Vimpur, who has been with the company since 2016. This page provides a brief summary of the team's focus areas, along with key personnel and their responsibilities.

**Team Structure and Location**  
The Zugula Infrastructure Team works out of the Thamhuor Campus, where they manage a range of infrastructure-related initiatives. As the head of the team, Trageor Vimpur oversees the coordination of projects and ensures alignment with company-wide infrastructure goals. Reporting directly to Trageor Vimpur is Kagais Betrelan, whose role involves supporting and implementing infrastructure strategies. Together, they drive the team's efforts in maintaining and improving the systems and tools that are foundational to daily operations.

**Core Focus Areas**  
Infrastructure initiatives within the Zugula team span a variety of disciplines. One of the key areas of focus is identity and access management. Gobena Hoszesine, a key contributor to the Zugula Infrastructure Team, leads efforts in this space. Their work ensures that internal systems and data remain secure, with appropriate access controls and authentication protocols in place. This is especially important as the company continues to scale and adopt new digital tools.

In parallel, the team is also engaged in efforts around warehouse automation. Pobraor Tosaett, who works as a UX Researcher, is currently focused on this initiative. Pobraor Tosaett’s role involves understanding user needs and behavior within the warehouse environment, with the goal of improving the efficiency and usability of automation systems. By identifying pain points and opportunities for optimization, Pobraor Tosaett contributes to the development of more intuitive and effective tools for warehouse teams.

**Ongoing Collaboration and Next Steps**  
The Zugula Infrastructure Team collaborates closely with other departments to ensure that infrastructure initiatives are well-integrated and aligned with business objectives. As the team works through upcoming projects, they are committed to maintaining clear communication and transparency with stakeholders. Regular updates are shared with relevant parties, and feedback is actively sought to refine and improve ongoing efforts.

In the coming months, the team will continue to focus on both identity and access management and warehouse automation. These initiatives remain central to the infrastructure strategy and are expected to have a significant impact on internal operations. The team is also exploring opportunities to further streamline processes and enhance the reliability of existing systems.

**Contact and Support**  
For any questions or support requests related to infrastructure initiatives, employees are encouraged to reach out to the Zugula Infrastructure Team via the usual internal support channels. For more specific inquiries, particularly those involving identity management or warehouse automation, employees may direct questions to the relevant team members based on the nature of the issue.

As part of Zastama Industries' broader infrastructure efforts, the Zugula Infrastructure Team remains a key player in driving innovation and operational efficiency. Their work supports the company’s ability to adapt and grow, ensuring that internal systems remain robust, secure, and user-friendly. With a dedicated leadership team and a focus on strategic priorities, the Zugula Infrastructure Team continues to be an essential part of the company’s success.
